title: The Handler
journal: Vosh-Leera sent me to the order's handler, Nesh-Deeka, at her house in Helstrom, the oldest city. I'm to ride the rootworm there from Jal-Veesa's Hist pool, paying Weeltul twenty-five gold, and find Nesh-Deeka's House. Cheeval-Xu, who works the rootworm at Helstrom's city tree, can point the way.
objectives: Speak to Nesh-Deeka in Nesh-Deeka's House, Helstrom. (marker: Nesh-Deeka)

plan.going: I carry the Unbound's names, their draught for "the Eye" and the seal to the order's handler.
plan.next: Ride the rootworm to Helstrom and speak to Nesh-Deeka in her house.
plan.ways: One way; the fare is twenty-five gold, and I have more than that.

answers: I am Tarin, a freed thief working for Vosh-Leera of Jal-Veesa. I rescued Sesk, who told me about the Unbound, a tribeless cult led by Cuts-the-Old-Knot that drains Hist sap, seals scars with grey paste called the seal, and sends jars to him for a draught tied to the Eye. Vosh-Leera sent me on to her handler.
Go to Nesh-Deeka at her house in Helstrom (door here) and speak to her. Cheeval-Xu can point the way.
Talk to Cheeval-Xu for directions, or go straight through the door to Nesh-Deeka House. The Boatmens Lodge door is another place to look.
I do not know what the Eye is, what the seal is made of, who Cuts-the-Old-Knot really is, or who Nesh-Deeka is. I can ask Nesh-Deeka and others.

title: The Handler
journal: Nesh-Deeka heard my report. The Eye is the Eye of Argonia, the old priest-kings' jewel of Hist amber. It lies at the Root, where every tree's roots meet under the sea, behind a gate the old kings sealed, and no living diver has found it. I said the draught must be to kill whatever guards the Root, and she agreed. To prove me, she wants a jar of stolen sap from Keel-Raa, an Unbound go-between lodging at the Boatmen's Lodge with two hired men. I can lift it from his pack on the crates behind them while they are not looking, buy it for a hundred gold, or fight the three of them for it, which the levy will not count as a crime. I'm to bring her the jar.
objectives: Get Keel-Raa's jar of sap at the Boatmen's Lodge (from his pack unseen, for 100 gold, or by a fight). (marker: Keel-Raa, Keel-Raa's Pack)

plan.going: Cuts-the-Old-Knot hunts the Eye of Argonia at the Root and brews her draught to kill its guardian. The order wants proof of me.
plan.next: Get Keel-Raa's jar at the Boatmen's Lodge and bring it to Nesh-Deeka.
plan.ways: Take the jar from his pack on the crates behind him unseen (Sneak); buy it for 100 gold, and he gives me the pack; or fight him and his two hired men (no crime: the levy ignores their band).

answers: Nesh-Deeka is the handler. She says the Eye is the Eye of Argonia, the priest-kings jewel of Hist amber, lying at the Root under the sea behind a sealed gate. Cuts-the-Old-Knot wants it and means to kill whatever guards the Root. She wants proof of me.
Go to the Boatmens Lodge in Helstrom and get the jar of stolen sap from Keel-Raa, then bring it to Nesh-Deeka.
Lift it from his pack unseen, buy it for 100 gold (I have about 150), or fight Keel-Raa and his two hired men. The levy will not count a fight as a crime.
I do not understand what the Root really is, what guards it, or what the levy is exactly. I can ask Keel-Raa or Nesh-Deeka.

title: The Handler
journal: I have Keel-Raa's jar of sap. I'm to bring it to Nesh-Deeka.
objectives: Bring Keel-Raa's jar to Nesh-Deeka. (marker: Nesh-Deeka)

plan.next: Bring it to Nesh-Deeka in her house.

answers: I killed Keel-Raa at the Boatmens Lodge and took his jar of stolen sap from his pack. I work for Vosh-Leera and Nesh-Deeka wants this as proof of me.
Take the jar to Nesh-Deeka in her house in Helstrom.
Bring it straight to her; I could also look around the lodge first, but nothing else is asked of me.
I still do not know what the Root guardian is, or what the seal is made of. I may learn more from Nesh-Deeka or from the sap itself.

title: The Handler
journal: Nesh-Deeka took the jar and made me a Voh-Vastei, an apprentice of the Toh-Reel-Ka, with the order's armour and two hundred gold; the order's traders will deal with me now. The order means to find the Root before the Unbound, and I am to use the Eye where it sits to heal the trees. Her one lead: an "Eye of Argonia" is for sale in Gideon's market. I'm to ride the rootworm from Helstrom's city tree to Gideon.

plan.going: I am a Voh-Vastei of the Toh-Reel-Ka. The order wants the Root found before the Unbound and the Eye used there to heal the trees.
plan.next: Ride the rootworm from Helstrom's city tree to Gideon and find the "Eye of Argonia" for sale (MN06).

answers: The quest is done. I killed Keel-Raa, took his sap jar and gave it to Nesh-Deeka. She made me Voh-Vastei, an apprentice of the Toh-Reel-Ka, and gave me light armour and 200 gold. The order wants to find the Root before the Unbound and use the Eye to heal the trees.

Ride the rootworm from Helstrom city tree to Gideon, with Cheeval-Xu calling it, and look into the Eye of Argonia for sale in Gideons market. Most such eyes are glass, so I need to find where it came from.
Go to Gideon straight away, or first ask Nesh-Deeka about the Root, the Xeech-Leel, Umbriel and the order. I can also trade with the order traders.
I do not understand the Xeech-Leel, Umbriel, or the order ranks. I can ask Nesh-Deeka about each of them.
